items.title: AWS Security Hub now exports findings to S3 in CSV or JSON format
items.blurb: Today, AWS Security Hub announces support for exporting findings to Amazon S3 in CSV or JSON (OCSF) format.

items.title: Amazon EC2 R8gd instances are now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8gd instances are available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

items.title: Amazon EC2 R8g instances now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8g instances are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

items.title: From zero to NanoClaw
items.blurb: Gavriel Cohen, creator of NanoClaw and co-founder of NanoCo, joins Adam to explain how a 40-hour weekend project became a viral open source hit and the foundation of an enterprise AI company.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports reasoning summaries for OpenAI models
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports the reasoning.summary parameter for OpenAI models through the Responses API.

items.title: AWS Lambda supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event sources
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event source mappings (ESM), including Kafka clusters that customers run themselves and managed offerings such as Confluent Cloud, Aiven, and Redpanda.

items.title: Amazon Quick now supports brand templates for on-brand presentations and documents
items.blurb: Starting today, you can upload brand templates in Amazon Quick, allowing you to create presentations and documents that match your approved visual identity.
